releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.171: Diary Lock not-set message appears in the same centered in-app popup box, not in a separate status area or browser alert. Matching signed APK and Check for Update feed; existing documents, saved images, notes, PIN, reminders and app identity are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: Web Update 249: Tareekh/Calendar Hijri day and month labels follow the selected app language: Roman English, English, Hindi, Urdu, Arabic, Bengali, Gujarati, Marathi, Tamil and Telugu. Full Hijri month names are shown where supported. Existing calendar events, notes and saved data are preserved.
